beats.narr: On Saturday, two people driving down Old Farm Road in Newton, Massachusetts, came upon a woman.
Two wild turkeys were chasing her.
A third turkey joined in. She told passers-by she had not been feeding them.
Two strangers pulled up and took her into their truck. She was not injured.

n261125j.end: The turkeys have the floor. Thanksgiving is Thursday.
